description: Marks the matched part of a result, so a list of hits shows WHY each one is a hit. Uses a real `<mark>`: the highlight is a semantic emphasis, not a colour, and a screen reader is entitled to know which words matched.

props.name: query
props.description: What to mark inside it. An empty query marks nothing.

props.name: caseSensitive
props.description: Off by default, which is what a search box wants: a reader who typed lower case still means the capitalised word. Turn it on only where case is part of the value, such as a code or an identifier.
